sun-care.title: Sunscreen & Sun Care in Cabo San Lucas
sun-care.description: High-SPF sunscreen, facial sunscreen and after-sun care delivered 24/7 to your hotel or villa in Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.
intro: Cabo gets strong sun almost every day of the year, and the reflection off the water and sand makes it easy to burn in under an hour. A broad-spectrum sunscreen of SPF 30 or higher, reapplied every two hours and after swimming, is the simplest way to protect your vacation.

We carry body and facial sunscreens, sprays for kids, after-sun gels with aloe and lotions for sunburn relief. If you're snorkeling or swimming at protected beaches, ask us for mineral (zinc or titanium) options that are gentler on the reef.

faq.q: What SPF should I use in Cabo?
faq.a: Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen of at least SPF 30, or SPF 50 for fair skin, kids and long days on a boat. Reapply every two hours and right after swimming or sweating.

faq.q: What helps a sunburn?
faq.a: Get out of the sun, cool the skin with water, apply an aloe vera or after-sun gel and drink plenty of fluids. If you have blisters over a large area, fever or chills, see a doctor; our English-speaking doctors can visit your hotel.

faq.q: Can you deliver sunscreen to the beach or my hotel?
faq.a: We deliver 24/7 to hotels, resorts and villas across Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo and the Corridor. Order on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the delivery time.

insect-repellents.title: Mosquito Repellent in Cabo San Lucas
insect-repellents.description: Mosquito repellents for adults and kids, plus itch relief for bug bites, delivered 24/7 to hotels and villas in Los Cabos.
intro: Mosquitoes in Los Cabos are most active at dawn, at dusk and after the summer rains, especially near gardens, golf courses and the estuary in San José del Cabo. Mosquitoes in Mexico can carry dengue, so it's worth protecting yourself even on a short trip.
We carry repellents with DEET and other active ingredients in cream, lotion and spray, gentle options for children, and creams and antihistamines to calm itchy bites.

faq.q: Which repellent works best against mosquitoes in Cabo?
faq.a: Repellents with DEET, picaridin or IR3535 give the longest protection. Apply them after sunscreen and reapply as the label indicates, especially in the evening.

faq.q: Is repellent safe for kids?
faq.a: Many repellents are labeled for children; always follow the minimum age on the product. Our pharmacists can recommend an option for your child's age.

faq.q: What should I do about itchy bites?
faq.a: Wash the area, avoid scratching and use an anti-itch cream or an oral antihistamine. If a bite becomes very swollen, hot or you develop fever and body aches, see a doctor.

digestive-gi-care.title: Traveler's Diarrhea & Stomach Medicine in Cabo
digestive-gi-care.h1: Stomach & traveler's diarrhea relief in Cabo
digestive-gi-care.description: Medicine for upset stomach and traveler's diarrhea, oral rehydration and gas relief, delivered 24/7 to your hotel or villa in Los Cabos.
intro: Traveler's diarrhea and an upset stomach are the most common reasons visitors call a pharmacy in Cabo. Most cases are mild and pass in a few days with rest, fluids and over-the-counter medicine.

We stock loperamide, bismuth subsalicylate, oral rehydration salts, probiotics and gas relief. If symptoms are severe, our English-speaking doctors can assess you and, when needed, prescribe treatment the same day.

faq.q: What can I take for traveler's diarrhea?
faq.a: Drink plenty of fluids with electrolytes and rest. Loperamide or bismuth subsalicylate can ease symptoms in adults. Avoid anti-diarrheal medicine if you have a high fever or blood in the stool, and see a doctor.

faq.q: When should I see a doctor?
faq.a: See a doctor if you have a high fever, blood in the stool, signs of dehydration (very little urine, dizziness), symptoms lasting more than three days, or if the patient is a small child, pregnant or elderly.

faq.q: Do I need a prescription for antibiotics?
faq.a: Yes. In Mexico antibiotics require a valid prescription. Our doctors can consult with you by video or at your hotel and we deliver the medicine afterwards.

heartburn-acid-relief.title: Heartburn & Acid Relief in Cabo San Lucas
heartburn-acid-relief.description: Antacids, famotidine and omeprazole for heartburn and indigestion, delivered 24/7 to hotels, resorts and villas in Los Cabos.
intro: Spicy food, late dinners and an all-inclusive bar can bring on heartburn and indigestion. Antacids work within minutes for occasional symptoms, while acid reducers give longer relief.
We carry chewable antacids, famotidine and omeprazole, plus liquid antacids that also help with gas. Tell us what you take at home and we'll match it or suggest an equivalent.

faq.q: What works fastest for heartburn?
faq.a: Chewable or liquid antacids neutralize stomach acid within minutes. For longer relief, acid reducers such as famotidine are an option; follow the label directions.

faq.q: Can I get my usual acid reflux medicine in Cabo?
faq.a: Usually yes, often under a Mexican brand name. Send us a photo of your box on WhatsApp and we'll find the same active ingredient.

faq.q: When is heartburn a reason to see a doctor?
faq.a: Get medical help right away for chest pain with shortness of breath, sweating or pain spreading to the arm or jaw, and see a doctor for heartburn that is frequent or doesn't improve with medicine.

pain-fever-relief.title: Pain & Fever Relief in Cabo San Lucas
pain-fever-relief.description: Ibuprofen, acetaminophen (paracetamol), naproxen and migraine relief for adults and kids, delivered 24/7 in Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.
intro: Headaches after a day in the sun, sore muscles from surfing or a child's fever: the basics for pain and fever are ibuprofen, acetaminophen (called paracetamol in Mexico) and naproxen.
We carry adult and children's formulas, liquid and chewable options and migraine relief. If you're not sure which one to take with your other medicines, our pharmacists can check for you.

faq.q: Is paracetamol the same as acetaminophen (Tylenol)?
faq.a: Yes. In Mexico acetaminophen is sold as paracetamol. It's the same active ingredient as Tylenol.

faq.q: Ibuprofen or acetaminophen?
faq.a: Ibuprofen also reduces inflammation, which helps with muscle and dental pain; acetaminophen is gentler on the stomach. People with stomach ulcers, kidney problems or who take blood thinners should ask a pharmacist before taking ibuprofen.

faq.q: When should a fever be checked by a doctor?
faq.a: See a doctor for a fever in a baby under three months, a fever above 39.4 °C (103 °F), a fever lasting more than three days or with a stiff neck, rash or confusion. Our doctors make hotel visits.

wound-care-first-aid.title: First Aid Supplies in Cabo San Lucas
wound-care-first-aid.h1: First aid & wound care in Cabo
wound-care-first-aid.description: Bandages, antiseptics, antibiotic ointment and first aid kits delivered 24/7 to your hotel, villa or boat in Los Cabos.
intro: Coral scrapes, cuts from rocks, blisters from long walks: a small first aid kit saves a lot of hassle on vacation. Clean the wound with water, use an antiseptic, cover it and keep it dry.
We carry adhesive bandages, gauze, antiseptic solutions, antibiotic ointment and ready-made first aid kits, which are popular with villa rentals and boat charters.

faq.q: What should be in a travel first aid kit?
faq.a: Adhesive bandages, gauze and tape, an antiseptic, antibiotic ointment, pain and fever medicine, an antihistamine, oral rehydration salts and tweezers.

faq.q: How do I treat a coral or rock scrape?
faq.a: Rinse it well with clean water, remove any debris, apply an antiseptic and antibiotic ointment and cover it. Watch for redness, warmth or swelling over the next days.

faq.q: When does a wound need a doctor?
faq.a: See a doctor for deep cuts, wounds that won't stop bleeding, animal bites, signs of infection or if your tetanus shot isn't up to date.

allergy-otc.title: Allergy Medicine in Cabo San Lucas
allergy-otc.description: Loratadine, cetirizine, fexofenadine, nasal sprays and anti-itch cream for allergies, delivered 24/7 to your hotel or villa in Los Cabos.
intro: Dust, pollen, pool chemicals or a new sunscreen can set off allergies on vacation. Non-drowsy antihistamines such as loratadine, cetirizine and fexofenadine are sold without a prescription in Mexico.
We also carry nasal sprays, allergy eye drops and anti-itch creams. Ask our pharmacists for the Mexican brand of the antihistamine you use at home.

faq.q: Can I buy Claritin, Zyrtec or Allegra in Cabo?
faq.a: Yes. Loratadine (Claritin), cetirizine (Zyrtec) and fexofenadine (Allegra) are available without a prescription, as the brand or as generics.

faq.q: Which antihistamine won't make me sleepy?
faq.a: Loratadine, cetirizine and fexofenadine are considered non-drowsy, although cetirizine can cause mild drowsiness in some people. Diphenhydramine (Benadryl) causes drowsiness.

faq.q: What if I have a severe allergic reaction?
faq.a: Swelling of the lips or tongue, trouble breathing or a widespread rash after a food or sting is an emergency: call 911 or go to the nearest hospital right away.

hydration-electrolytes.title: Electrolytes & Hangover Relief in Cabo
hydration-electrolytes.description: Oral rehydration salts and electrolyte drinks for heat, hangovers and upset stomach, delivered 24/7 to hotels and villas in Los Cabos.
intro: Heat, sun, alcohol and stomach bugs all dehydrate you faster than you think in Cabo. Electrolyte drinks and oral rehydration salts replace both water and minerals, so they work better than water alone.
We deliver electrolyte powders and drinks, effervescent tablets and the basics for the morning after, any hour of the day or night.

faq.q: What are the signs of dehydration?
faq.a: Thirst, dark urine, headache, dizziness and fatigue. Drink an electrolyte solution in small sips and rest in the shade or air conditioning.

faq.q: What helps a hangover?
faq.a: Rehydrate with electrolytes, eat something light and rest. Acetaminophen should be avoided after heavy drinking; ask our pharmacist for a safer option.

faq.q: Can you deliver at night?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver 24/7 to hotels, resorts and villas in Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo and the Corridor.

cold-flu.title: Cold & Flu Medicine in Cabo San Lucas
cold-flu.description: Cold and flu relief, cough syrups, decongestants and throat lozenges, delivered 24/7 to your hotel or villa in Cabo San Lucas.
intro: Air conditioning, flights and crowded pools make colds common on vacation. Most improve in a week with rest, fluids and medicine for the symptoms.
We carry multi-symptom cold and flu formulas, cough syrups, decongestants, throat lozenges and saline sprays for adults and kids.

faq.q: What can I take for a cold in Mexico?
faq.a: Multi-symptom formulas combine a pain reliever with a decongestant and an antihistamine. Check the label so you don't double up on acetaminophen (paracetamol) with other medicines.

faq.q: Are cold medicines safe with high blood pressure?
faq.a: Decongestants such as phenylephrine and pseudoephedrine can raise blood pressure. Ask our pharmacist for an alternative if you have hypertension or heart disease.

faq.q: When should I see a doctor for flu symptoms?
faq.a: See a doctor for trouble breathing, chest pain, a high fever that lasts more than three days, or if symptoms improve and then get worse. Our doctors can visit your hotel.
